name: (02) Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno) — 1 Basic — Flame Lance

system.description:
Pointing at their target and twisting their wrist to trace a portal in the air, the infernalist looses a pencil-thin stream of bright green hellfire that reaches out in a perfectly straight line.

Make a Mental Challenge that the target resists with their Physical Traits; on a win they suffer one level of aggravated damage. You may also use Flame Lance to ignite flammable inanimate targets, though it will not set fire to anything the target is wearing. This flame is supernatural, so ordinary fire protection and body armor provide no defense, and its range is your line of sight. Retest with Occult.
